title: Angel Voices, Ever Singing
description: Angel Voices, Ever Singing in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 5 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Francis Pott, first published in 1861. The tune, ANGEL VOICES (MONK), is by Edwin George Monk (1861). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: An-gel voi-ces, e-ver sing-ing, round Thy throne of light, An-gel harps, for-e-ver ring-ing, rest not day or night; Thou-sands on-ly live to bless Thee, and con-fess Thee Lord of might.

lines: Thousands only live to bless Thee,
and confess Thee Lord of might.
Thou Who art beyond the farthest
Can it be that Thou regardest
Can we feel that Thou art near us
and wilt hear us? Yea, we can.
Lord, we know Thy love rejoices
Thou didst ears and hands and voices
Here, great God, today we offer
Hearts and minds, and hands and voices,
Of the best that Thou hast given
